name: endpoint-trust-audit
description: Unofficial, read-only skill for the 2026 eMudhra weak intermediate CA key incident: checks this computer's CA bundles, trust stores, keychains and TLS settings using only OS-standard commands.

interface.shortDescription: Check PC trust of eMudhra keys
interface.longDescription: Unofficial community skill, not affiliated with eMudhra. Read-only check of this computer's CA bundles, OS trust stores, keychains and CA override files against the compromised eMudhra intermediate SPKI hashes, plus CA package versions and TLS-disabling settings, using only OS-standard commands. Reports evidence, confidence and coverage gaps; never changes anything or sends data.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer still trusts the compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys
Look for TLS verification being disabled on this machine
